invariants.name: carry_trigger_digit_condition
invariants.description: A number is irresponsible if and only if there exists a digit position i where the sum of the digit d_i and the corresponding digit of x+1 exceeds or equals the base B. This condition can be expressed locally using d_i and the incoming carry from lower positions, leading to a stable threshold-based test.

invariants.name: critical_prefix_suffix_decomposition
invariants.description: For counting irresponsible numbers up to a given decimal string, the first (most significant) position where the digit is at least the threshold divides the string into a prefix and a suffix. Digits in the suffix after this critical position contribute independently: any suffix value yields an irresponsible number once the prefix has exceeded the threshold, modulo a fixed adjustment for boundary values captured by the function F.

properties.critical_position: first index i with d_i >= threshold
properties.suffix_independence: for positions i > critical_idx, every choice of digits yields an irresponsible number; contribution is d_i * B^{remaining_length}

invariants.name: geometric_periodic_summation
invariants.description: When the base digit string is repeated multiple times, the total count of irresponsible numbers can be expressed as a geometric series in powers of B^{L} where L is the length of the string. The contributions from each repetition are additive and follow a geometric progression, allowing computation via modular inverses and closed-form formulas.
